selection_rule: highest validation macro F1 among eight recorded experiments
known_limitations: The recorded split was image-level and did not enforce exact-copy grouping.
Perceptual-hash review candidates were not adjudicated for the recorded split.
Five exact duplicate pairs were later identified within the Viral Pneumonia class.
Patient identifiers were unavailable, so patient-level independence was not established.
No external cohort, calibration study or uncertainty analysis was recorded.
These values are retained for provenance and are not fresh benchmark results.
